ev.q: From 2000 to 2010, HIV disease death rates decreased approximately 70% for both black and white men aged 25–44 years.
Throughout the period, HIV disease death rates for black men were at least six times the rates for white men.
human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) disease death rates among men aged 25-54 years
Rates decreased by 53% for black men aged 45–54 years and 34% for white men aged 45–54 years.
Throughout the period, HIV disease death rates for black men were at least six times the rates for white men.
From 2000 to 2010, HIV disease death rates decreased approximately 70% for both black and white men aged 25–44 years.
National Vital Statistics System, United States, 2000–2010
